summary: Found one repository: aferikoglou/CollectiveHLS, which is the authors' own implementation of the CollectiveHLS system described in the paper. It was found by searching GitHub for the system name. The paper itself does not include a direct URL to this repository. The repo contains Python code that orchestrates Vitis HLS, with weak HLS content (references to Vitis HLS in Python scripts). No third-party repos that the paper builds on were identified beyond standard benchmark suites (RodiniaHLS, Machsuite) which are separate projects. The evidence is very strong: the repo description is the exact paper title, the README cites the paper with full bibliographic details, the owner is the lead author, and all commits are by the lead author.
